messages:
Ayaan: Day 3 async check-in — what I did: set up laptop, joined VPN, cloned monorepo, ran quick unit tests.

Ayaan: Blockers: 
- docker pull from internal registry returns 401 Unauthorized
- kubectl to dev cluster errors: "Error from server (Unauthorized)"
- MFA keeps prompting after SSO login

Ayaan: Today I'll try to repro registry auth, open infra ticket, and get my first tiny onboarding PR up. @Isha can we pair later if infra needs dev-cluster perms? :wave:

Isha: @Ayaan welcome — I can pair at 3pm PT. For kubectl first try `kubectl config view --minify` and check current-context.
Isha: If you see an AWS SSO session missing, try `aws sso login --profile redwood-dev` and then `kubectl get pods -n dev`.

Jordan: Hey @Ayaan, for the registry we usually do:
```
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
```
Also check `~/.docker/config.json` for the auth entry.

infra-bot: Provisioning ticket created: #INFRA-678 (assigned to infra-team). ETA for initial check: 2h. :gear:

Priya: @Ayaan People Ops updated your building access and sent an MFA reset link to your email. Let me know if you need an override for today.

Isha: Also quick heads-up — I left a tiny comment on your onboarding PR (link) to add a README snippet. Ping me once updated and I'll review quickly. :thumbsup:

Ayaan: Thanks! I'll try Jordan's commands now and DM logs if kubectl still fails. See you at 3pm @Isha. Updating PR after registry access.
